summary: Fun Blitz after a cleanup: casual players name 20+ scoring companies. Weak as a classic daily, because players think of market value and lose lives on Microsoft, Tesla and Meta.
reasons: Casual run: Apple, Amazon, Walmart, Google and Aramco found, but Microsoft (#19), Exxon (#13), Toyota (#17), Tesla (unranked) and Meta (#46) used up all five lives by guess 10. Big tech by market value is the obvious wrong idea, and every one of those guesses costs a life.
Top 10 is right (Fortune Global 500 order). State Grid, CNPC and Sinopec are fair stretch answers for fans; a fan got 10/10 with 4 lives lost, one of them a PetroChina bug.
Blitz suits it well: 21 of 28 quick casual names scored (oil majors, carmakers, banks, Costco). Data issues below keep it at fix-first.
fixes: 'PetroChina' is an alias of #5 China National Petroleum Corporation, but the unranked extra 'Petro China' catches the guess first and costs a life. Drop the unranked 'Petro China' entry so 'petrochina' finds #5.
Add 'CVS' as an alias of #11 CVS Health (currently not recognized).
Countries in the unranked pool: 'United States', 'United Kingdom', 'Japan', 'Germany'. They are not companies and cost a life. Remove them.
Duplicate entities in the unranked pool: merge 'Royal Dutch Shell' into #15 Shell, and 'Samsung' into #33 Samsung Electronics (today 'samsung' brings up a choice and the unranked one scores nothing).
ICBC (#24) alias 'The Bank of East Asia' is a different bank; drop it.

Junk redirect aliases on top-10 entries: Amazon 'Sonic', 'Just Do It Award', 'Indigo Starfish', 'Lobbying by Amazon', 'Lobbying by Amazon.com', 'Controversies surrounding Amazon, Inc.', 'Amazon leadership principles', 'Commingled inventory', 'Co-mingled inventory', 'Comingled inventory'; Apple ' Inc.' Adams', 'Boycott Apple', 'Directly Responsible Individual', 'Apple tax', 'Apple tax practices', 'Tax avoidance by Apple Inc.'; Walmart 'GamePlay', 'Supercenter', 'Discount City', 'Save Money.
